title: Cross-source grocery trade-item matching benchmark
protocol: One manual annotation pass before execution. Same means corroborated exact trade item. Different means affirmative pack, flavour, formulation, brand or construction difference. Uncertain means evidence conflicts or leaves important fields missing. Independent sources refer to separate published records, with the possibility of common manufacturer data upstream.
limits: India-market OFF sample and US product-label stress cases. No authorized Indian retailer feeds, independent second annotator, sampling representativeness or model training. Matcher inputs preserve observed source descriptions where possible, with dual metric quantities supplied in one consistent notation. Individual quantities are not inferred by dividing a rounded total.
attribution: Open Food Facts contributors (ODbL 1.0 / DbCL 1.0), USDA FoodData Central (CC0 1.0), and the identified brand-owner or public product page links. Manufacturer imagery and retailer prices are not redistributed.
